_comment: 32a (Siemens star, 30 keV, parallel beam + objective-FZP scan). Positions in um: FZP X x 2.5 um, FZP Y x 0.2 um (see report: 0.2 um makes the scan rings circular). Lens shift d -> pupil shift d/(lambda p): 'czp_focal_m' is used as p (=0.75 m, not measured) with stage_step_um = 1 (positions in um). Input = d32a/data_reg (dark offset 100 subtracted, stage-rounding shifts corrected), so dark_offset = 0. Bright-field set: rings 0-2 (60 images, |k|/kc 0.49-0.82 as the median per ring, 0.43-0.87 over the images from the calibration). dr = 200 nm. Calibration from the direct-image vignetting (d32a/make_calib_32a.py), not from the WOTF step; twin forced +1.
